description:
A single X post (tweet) by URL or ID: text, author, reply/quote/retweet info, media and engagement counts including views.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `id`.
Returns: id (string), link (string, nullable), text (string), lang (string, nullable), created_at (string, nullable), author_username (string, nullable), is_pinned (boolean), is_retweet (boolean), retweeted_from (string, nullable), is_reply (boolean), in_reply_to (string, nullable), is_quote (boolean), quoted (object, nullable), reply_count (integer, nullable), retweet_count (integer, nullable), quote_count (integer, nullable), like_count (integer, nullable), bookmark_count (integer, nullable), view_count (integer, nullable), media (array<object>).

id.description: Tweet ID; used only when url is empty. Example: "20"

url.description: Tweet URL (a bare tweet ID also works). Example: "https://x.com/jack/status/20"

name: x_post
title: X post
